adjudication.rationale: In handleNewBooking.ts the event is built with `destinationCalendar: ... : null` when neither `eventType.destinationCalendar` nor `organizerUser.destinationCalendar` exists. Immediately after, for collective team events, it does `evt.destinationCalendar?.push(...teamDestinationCalendars)`. If `evt.destinationCalendar` is `null`, optional chaining makes this a silent no-op, so any `teamDestinationCalendars` collected from other users are dropped. This prevents creating destination calendar events for team members in the collective case when the organizer lacks a destination calendar. The diff shows this exact control flow and data loss.
